_provenance: Preliminary numbers from the original Google Colab notebook (T4 GPU). Every entry is a SINGLE, UNSEEDED run, so differences of a few IoU points are within run-to-run noise. They are kept for the record and as a sanity check for the reproducible scripts; they are NOT the headline results. Fields set to null were not recorded in a form that could be verified when this file was written.

setup.dataset: SpaceNet-2 PS-RGB, AOI_3_Paris (1148 images) and AOI_5_Khartoum (1012 images), 650x650, 3-band uint16
setup.optimizer: Adam lr=1e-3 (cosine annealing in the 8-epoch runs)

runs.name: untrained_sanity_check
runs.description: ImageNet encoder + random decoder, no training, Paris batch
runs.note: The model predicted ~52% of pixels as building (pred_frac 0.522), i.e. IoU 0.114 is what 'predict everything' gives when ~10% of pixels are buildings.

runs.name: baseline_5ep
runs.description: Paris-trained, global normalization (clip(x/2000)), flips only, 5 epochs, best epoch by Paris val IoU

runs.name: zscore
runs.note: Evaluated with the notebook's `evaluate`. An earlier `evaluate_full` helper clamped inputs to [0,1], which broke z-scored inputs (it reported Paris 0.138); that bug is fixed in this repo (metrics.evaluate never rescales inputs).

runs.name: transfer_matrix_8ep
runs.description: 2x2 matrix: train city x evaluation city, 8 epochs
runs.note: Superseded: the reproducible 3-seed results are in results/runs/*.json and results/summary.md.

runs.name: few_shot_paris_to_khartoum
runs.description: Fine-tune the Paris model on N Khartoum images (10 epochs, lr 3e-4) vs an ImageNet-only control
runs.known_flaw: the ImageNet-only control used lr=1e-3 while the Paris-pretrained model used 3e-4; scripts/few_shot.py uses the same lr for both by default

qualitative_observations: Brightness matching at test time and brightness augmentation at training time did not improve Khartoum IoU; the brightness-augmented model produced near-empty predictions on Khartoum.
Per-image z-score normalization did not improve transfer to Khartoum.
The baseline Paris model predicted coarse blobs rather than individual footprints on Khartoum.
Picking the epoch with the best same-city validation IoU does not necessarily pick the epoch that transfers best.
